adversarial_cases.case: baseline transformation
adversarial_cases.expected: both backends match independent Q/proposal/Xfer/reset oracle

adversarial_cases.case: multiple fields use same old-Q snapshot
adversarial_cases.expected: proposal (17,4), not mixed current/next values

adversarial_cases.case: reread owner after proposing
adversarial_cases.expected: read remains committed old Q

adversarial_cases.case: disabled proposal then enabled evaluation
adversarial_cases.expected: hold then recompute from Q; no stale D replay

adversarial_cases.case: reset while a proposal is pending
adversarial_cases.expected: full reset image, skip ordinary rules, discard pending, deterministic replay

adversarial_cases.case: two owned registers, local immutable value aliases/helper rebindings, and record-valued child-port forwarding
adversarial_cases.expected: owned declarations have distinct StateIDs; local value aliases add no storage; record ports/forwarding reject; scalar child aliases remain separate baseline

adversarial_cases.case: same-shaped but different nominal record
adversarial_cases.expected: reject nominal mismatch

adversarial_cases.case: field order/name/type differs between source/header and producer snapshot; compare with coherent standalone final reorder
adversarial_cases.expected: reject source/header/snapshot mismatch; standalone final is judged for present ordering/type/use consistency, with no claim to recover historical order

adversarial_cases.case: remove executable constructor body and fresh-emit; then tamper retained constructor provenance
adversarial_cases.expected: fresh emit works without Python/header/helper body; constructor must equal sym_name + .__init__ as non-callable provenance, with no final function lookup

adversarial_cases.case: field missing/duplicate/reordered/type-changed against source/header or frozen producer snapshot; separately coherent standalone edit
adversarial_cases.expected: reject source/snapshot disagreement and intrinsic malformed final; a self-consistent standalone change may define a different final artifact

adversarial_cases.case: owner/symbol association tamper
adversarial_cases.expected: common final verifier rejects

adversarial_cases.case: origin tamper including origin definition only
adversarial_cases.expected: reject internally inconsistent origin/symbol relation and producer snapshot mismatch; coherent standalone rewrite is not proof of original source

adversarial_cases.case: reset image incomplete/ill-typed/out-of-range, plus a coherent in-range standalone reset edit
adversarial_cases.expected: reject invalid image and producer-side changed snapshot; a different internally valid standalone image may be accepted

adversarial_cases.case: assert-then-return original record parameter, followed by caller range-unsafe actual/observation
adversarial_cases.expected: helper return-use exit path remains distinct from binding path; failed assert suppresses caller continuation and all next commits; false guard skips helper

adversarial_cases.case: record class decorated @module or record field mutation
adversarial_cases.expected: reject frontend boundary violation

adversarial_cases.case: unsupported record/helper final declaration outside approved projection
adversarial_cases.expected: explicit rejection; no silent drop or preflight removal

adversarial_cases.case: record-valued public report/trace/typed ABI
adversarial_cases.expected: not introduced; observe two scalar fields through existing mechanism

adversarial_cases.case: failed emit with existing output sentinel
adversarial_cases.expected: sentinel bytes remain unchanged

adversarial_cases.case: single-contribution guard/path false, including a field range that excludes zero
adversarial_cases.expected: rule and module selectors produce typed zero-bit aggregate placeholder with E=false and Q holds; true case selects both fields from the same source aggregate

adversarial_cases.case: tamper rule/module selector condition, scalar get, true/false operands, zero bits/type, aggregate create/target, or add placeholder use/origin
adversarial_cases.expected: common verify-only and both emits reject malformed exact-use/placement shape before publication
